title: FullTestSession
description: As-shipped resume snapshot. localStorage key `sc.exam.<testId>`; written on every meaningful change by ExamRunner via lib/exam-session.ts. Sessions older than 3h are treated as expired and cleared on load (EVAL_SET: Session Expiry).

mi.description: module index into ExamTest.modules (0=R&W M1, 1=R&W M2, 2=Math M1, 3=Math M2)

qi.description: question index within the current module

secLeft.description: seconds left in the section clock; null when untimed

phase.description: 'break' = the 10-minute break between R&W and Math

answers.description: AnswerMap: '<moduleId>:<questionNumber>' -> choice id or SPR string

finished.description: cleared from storage on finish; never resumed

planned-hardening: Supabase mirror for cross-device resume (EVAL_SET: Cross-Device Resume).
Server-issued signed session token binding startTime + 134-min duration (EVAL_SET: Exceeding Time / Tampering). The exam-session module is the seam for this; UI logic is unchanged when added.
x-implementation.deltas-from-spec: Spec used currentSection R&W/Math + currentModule 1..2; as-shipped uses a single module index (mi) which is equivalent and avoids a redundant field. answers keys are '<moduleId>:<n>', not 'Q...'.
